sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, seeking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that defeat, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, sitting 2 points clear of second-placed Stafford Town. Alsager Town are struggling at the foot of the division with just 4 points and will present a winnable fixture for the league leaders.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host Dawley Town in what could be a title-race statement, with the visitors sitting mid-table on 11 points. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face sixth-placed Eccleshall at home in a crucial top-half encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points in fourth, travel to Wednesfield Community (13 points), while Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a mid-table clash between two sides separated by just one point. Shawbury United, winless in their last six, host Barnton who have picked up three points from their last two games. Cheadle Heath Nomads, struggling on 7 points, visit Telford Town (6 points) in a basement battle. Market Drayton Town (12 points) travel to New Mills (14 points), while Crewe host Allscott Heath in a meeting of two sides both seeking consistency. Brereton Social face Widnes Town, the division's bottom side with just 2 points from 7 games.
